title: Himannaa Aangoo Mul’ataa
intro: Bara durii namni humna guddaa qabu tokko lafa bal’aa fi jiraattota ishee irratti ol’aantummaa argachuuf ka’a ture. Bulchiinsi nama kanaa of tuulummaa guddaa fi qormaata guddaa aangoo Waaqayyoo irratti kan mulʼate ture. Lubbuu hireen dhumaa ishee dhaloota hundaaf barumsa waaraa ta’e eenyummaa ishee saaxiluuf qophaa’i.
clues: Impaayera jabaa, bakka dubbiin koo seera ta’etti ol’aantummaa qabadheera.
Bulchiinsa koo jala jiran hunda irraa waaqeffannaa gaafachaa, waaqa ol’aanaa ta’uu koo of labse.
Hawaasa murtaa’e tokko cunqursee, garboomsee dhiira isaanii daa’imman akka ajjeefaman ajaje.
Ergamaa Waaqayyoo gad of deebisu, kan anaa fi falfaltoota koo duratti dinqii ifa ta’e raawwate irra deddeebi’ee na mudate.
Ergamaa sana falfalaan himadhee isa fi hordoftoota isaa balleessuuf shira xaxeen mata jabinaan dhugaa dide.
Aniifi waraanni koo guutuun warra harka koo jalaa ba’an boqonnaa malee hordofaa osoo jirruu galaanaan liqimfamne.
arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verse: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them, (20:78)
